chapter: New York dance bands and Dorsey
title: Haymes band personnel and Haymes's stage fright
summary: Freeman names others in the Haymes band, later taken over by Tommy Dorsey, and says Haymes feared the public.

story.theme_name: Who was in the band: naming sidemen and personnel
story.community_name: Who played in the band: reciting personnel

blocks.x: I hope you are wrong, but anyway, so let's see who else was in the band. I don't think there

was anybody -- oh, yes, Johnny Mince was in the band before I got in it, but that was the band that Tommy Dorsey was to take over, Joe Haynes is a very sensitive sort of guy, but he used to wish that he could stand behind the band, he was so frightened of the public. But He was a marvelous talent.
